estado: First rendering/runtime proof implemented · human review pending

agora.titulo: One room runs in the custom Rust runtime
agora.texto: Real Blender-generated animated sprites, linear normals and dynamic light, 3D room geometry, planar collision, side-following camera and a bounded executable movement graph. Six focused tests and native startup passed.

Keyboard/mouse/controller mappings are implemented; physical input playtest and human visual review remain pending. The simple armor and blockout room do not replace the approved references. See Documentation for the eight-second GPU replay and lighting comparison.

agora.titulo: Next: visual room and graph authoring
agora.texto: Use the same runtime for validated map/graph save/reload and playtest instances that preserve authored data. Full gameplay, progression and the complete level remain future work.

comVoce.texto: Run the first native proof and review the technical proxy. Device behavior and final art quality have not been owner-accepted.
